quote: Upon approaching an authorized emergency vehicle or an official vehicle of a regulatory agency which is moving or preparing to move in any direction, including, without limitation, arriving at or leaving the scene of a crash or other incident, and making use of flashing lights meeting the requirements of subsection 3 of NRS 484A.480 [DEF-NRS-484A-480-3], the driver of any other vehicle shall, except when otherwise directed by a law enforcement officer: If possible, drive in a lane that is not adjacent to the lane in which the authorized emergency vehicle or official vehicle of a regulatory agency is moving, unless roadway, traffic, weather or other conditions make doing so unsafe or impossible. As used in this section, “preparing to move” means any indication that is visible to an approaching driver that an authorized emergency vehicle or an official vehicle of a regulatory agency is about to move, including, without limitation: (a) A movement of the vehicle; or (b) The use of hand signals by the driver of the vehicle.

activation.condition: Approach a qualifying moving or visibly preparing authorized emergency or regulatory official vehicle using qualifying flashing lights.

obligation.description: If possible, drive in a lane not adjacent to the target unit lane, subject to stated road, traffic, weather or other unsafe/impossible conditions.

exceptions.source_clause: except when otherwise directed by a law enforcement officer
exceptions.description: Source-backed officer direction can alter the driver's lane response.

exceptions.source_clause: unless roadway, traffic, weather or other conditions make doing so unsafe or impossible
exceptions.description: Original condition facts needed; statutory safety and possibility remain unresolved.

timing.description: Observe ego approach, target motion or visible preparation, flashing use and lane trajectory over all original 45 seconds.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Record connected nonadjacent lane route, ego footprint and actual traffic/road/weather circumstances; no legal cutoff.
Record road geometry, occupied traffic corridor, weather, visibility and surface; leave statutory judgment unresolved.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: any indication that is visible to an approaching driver
judgment_calls_needed.note: Review original driver-view pixels and movement or hand-signal timing.
